target_customer: Health and wellness brands that need onboarding funnels and intake flows without engineering time
problem: Brands collect user information with form builders like Typeform or custom code, which are either limited or need engineering bandwidth.
business_model: B2B SaaS, with pricing reported by the company as charged when a funnel goes live

founders.name: Matthew Morley
founders.background_notes: YC page lists interests in go-to-market, democracy and civic tech. No employer or education found.

founders.name: Jeremy Evans
founders.background_notes: YC page says he started in journalism, teaching and politics and has built democracy tools such as voter quizzes. Company was formerly called Savvy.

technical_complexity.rationale: Civic quiz widgets and later form and funnel builders are mostly standard web engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Many form builders exist and the product is copyable; no network or data moat found.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Typeform and many form tools kept growing; no incumbent bought Embeddables.

market_need_then: In 2018 the company was Savvy, a civic engagement quiz tool, so the demand evidence for the current funnel product is from later years. Typeform's reported 2018 traction shows demand for friendly forms.

branding.domain_note: Uses embeddables.com. Another company, Embeddable (embeddable.com and embeddable.co), has a very similar name.

rebrands.why: not stated; YC page says formerly Savvy and operating entity is Savvy Technology Inc. DBA Embeddables

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community about the brand found and the name is easily confused with the similarly named Embeddable.

pivots.from: Savvy, civic engagement and voter quiz tools for brands
pivots.to: Embeddables, funnel builder for health and wellness brands

outcome_analysis: The company entered YC in 2018 as Savvy, a civic engagement tool, and later became Embeddables, a low-code funnel builder aimed at health and wellness brands. Only a small accelerator investment is visible in trackers, no acquisition or shutdown was found, and the YC page shows 23 people, so it looks like a small bootstrapped or lightly funded survivor that found a niche after a pivot. The timing of the pivot is not sourced.
notes: YC page says founded 2024 while CB Insights says 2019; neither is relied on. CB Insights lists $120K total from Y Combinator and Newfund Capital and PitchBook shows $125K accelerator deal in August 2018 (both seen only in a search summary, unverified, so not recorded as rounds). The competitor listed is from the current product positioning; Savvy's 2018 civic rivals were not identified. The pivot date and the 2018 product were not confirmed from a dated source. Removed the Typeform competitor: its source is a 2018 Latka interview about Typeform itself and the link to Embeddables came from current positioning, not a source dated near the 2018 founding. The YC deal (CB Insights about 120K July 2018, PitchBook 125K) was seen only in aggregator search summaries and not opened, so it is still not recorded. Completeness pass: the 120K seed (July 2018) rests on CB Insights alone; PitchBook shows a 125K accelerator deal on 2018-08-21, likely the same YC deal, not summed. A Seedtable seed of March 2020 for a company called Savvy lists other investors and may be a different company, so it is not recorded.
